parameters.stack_fork_side_min: lc_drive_fork_gap - tol_fork_gap_minus - lc_rod_thickness - tol_rod_thickness_plus - 2 * ( fit_bushing_flange_thickness + tol_bushing_flange_plus )
parameters.stack_fork_side_max: lc_drive_fork_gap + tol_fork_gap_plus - lc_rod_thickness + tol_rod_thickness_minus - 2 * ( fit_bushing_flange_thickness - tol_bushing_flange_minus )
parameters.stack_spacer_excess_min: lc_knee_spacer_length - tol_spacer_length_minus - ( lc_bearing_span + tol_bearing_station_span_plus - lc_bearing_width + tol_bearing_width_minus )
parameters.stack_spacer_excess_max: lc_knee_spacer_length + tol_spacer_length_plus - ( lc_bearing_span - tol_bearing_station_span_minus - lc_bearing_width - tol_bearing_width_plus )
